events.name: The Long Chain
events.intro: A market stall, a girl standing on a crate to see over it. Market child Bea: "I'll trade you this Oran Berry for your shiniest pebble!" She means a Hard Stone, or anything rocky.

requires.label: a Hard Stone or a Rock-type item

success.text: Bea holds it up to the sun, gasps, and gives you the Oran Berry. Then a hug, around the middle, very hard. "Best trade ever."
"Next time!" Bea goes back to polishing her own pebbles.

events.name: The Long Chain
events.intro: A hiker sitting on his pack, stomach growling. Hungry hiker Gus: "I'd swap my compass for a Berry. I mean it. Any Berry. That Oran would do."

success.text: Gus eats it in two bites, sighs, and presses a brass compass into your hand. "Points true. Always has."
"That's alright," Gus says, and means it. "It's yours to keep."

events.name: The Long Chain
events.intro: An old sailor squinting at the sky, turning in a slow circle. Lost sailor Brinner: "A compass! I'll give you my spare Pokémon for it. I've been lost three days."

success.text: Brinner kisses the compass, gets his bearings, and hands you a Wingull. "She's a natural flyer. Better than me at finding home."

gives.why: I've been lost three days. A compass is worth more to me now.

success.text: "That's alright," Brinner says, and means it. "It's yours to keep."

events.name: The Long Chain
events.intro: A man with a feather in his hat and three birds on his arm. Bird-keeper Perry: "That Wingull's a natural. I'll swap my Swablu's egg for it. I'll hold the egg for you until you decide."

success.text: Perry takes the Wingull onto his arm with the others. It fits right in. He shows you the Swablu egg, warm in a nest of feathers. "Yours. I'll carry it till the next stop."
"That's alright," Perry says, and means it. "It's yours to keep."

events.name: The Long Chain
events.intro: Perry catches you up, the Swablu egg in his hands. Beside him, a woman with dragon scales sewn into her coat. Dragon fancier Ysra: "A Swablu egg! I'll give you a Dragon Scale and a story."

success.text: Ysra cradles the egg and tells you the story: a Swablu that sang until it grew into a dragon of the clouds. Then a Dragon Scale, cool and heavy, in your palm.
Perry hands the egg to you. It is warm, and something inside it shifts. "Good choice too," Ysra says. "Every choice is."

events.name: The Long Chain
events.intro: An old man in robes by a mountain shrine. Dragon clan elder Ryuen: "A scale freely traded all this way. Pebble, Berry, compass, wing, egg. That is worth a Dratini."

success.text: Ryuen bows. A Dratini uncoils from his sleeve and looks up at you. "It began with a child's pebble. Remember that."

marks: the end of the long chain
gives.why: A scale freely traded all this way is worth a Dratini.

success.text: "That's alright," Ryuen says, and means it. "It's yours to keep."

events.name: The Short Chain
events.intro: A boy in a too-big cap with a Bellsprout on his shoulder. Kid Rocco: "Grass beats you! Swap? I want a Fire-type. A real one, level 5 or more."

success.text: Rocco whoops and hands over the Bellsprout. "Look after it! It likes being watered at night."

wants.label: a Fire-type at level 5 or more

gives.why: Grass beats you! I want a Fire-type.

success.text: "Your loss!" Rocco says, and his Bellsprout waves at you.

events.name: The Short Chain
events.intro: A treehouse, a girl hanging upside down from the ladder. Kid Ivy-May: "Bellsprout for Leafy's sister! She's a Fomantis. She's very fancy."

success.text: Ivy-May climbs down and solemnly swaps. "Leafy will be so happy. Say hello to Bodhi for me, he's by the sea."
"That's alright," Ivy-May says, and means it. "It's yours to keep."

events.name: The Short Chain
events.intro: A lighthouse, a boy waving from the bottom step. Kid Bodhi: "Fomantis has never seen the sea! I'll swap my Chinchou. She's got a ribbon."

success.text: Bodhi shows the Fomantis the sea. It stares for a full minute. Then he hands you the Chinchou, ribbon and all. "All three of us traded. That's a chain!"

marks: the end of the short chain
gives.why: Fomantis has never seen the sea!

success.text: "That's alright," Bodhi says, and means it. "It's yours to keep."
